question: Which chapter of the Aṃśumān-Kāśyapa concludes the seven-tāla procedure?
premises: The section concerns the seven-tāla procedure.
The chapter is identified as the sixty-third.
inference: The sixty-third chapter of the Aṃśumān-Kāśyapa presents the seven-tāla procedure.
plain_english: Thus ends the sixty-third chapter, on the procedure of the seven-tāla system, in the Aṃśumān-Kāśyapa.
